$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation and autocomplete.

id.description: Stable UUID v4 interaction instance id referenced by agent interaction_instance_id.

creator_user_id.description: UUID v4 id of the GUI user who created this interaction instance.

enabled.description: Whether agents may reference this interaction instance.

request_topic.description: ntfy topic used for approval request notifications.

response_topic.description: ntfy topic polled for approval responses.

token.description: Optional bearer token for ntfy publish and poll requests.

poll_interval.description: Interval for polling the ntfy response topic.

poll_timeout.description: Timeout for ntfy publish and poll HTTP requests.

responded_by.description: responded_by value used for ntfy approval responses.
